summary: The red-box urgent criteria are well captured in one Urgent rule with sensible concepts and correct splitting of compounds. The most consequential gap is that the whole 'ensure seen promptly' box (BP, pulse, temperature, glucose, SpO2 thresholds) has no priority rule, and the pregnancy/hypertension/diabetes check lists are only partly encoded as measure tasks. SNOMED semantic tags on a few concepts were not verified and should be checked.
